verses.gurmukhi: ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਕੀਨੋ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rachanaa charitr chitr bisam bachitr pan kaahoo so na kouoo keeno ek hee anek hai ||

en.bdb: Miracle of His creation is wondrous and astonishing. No human being has been created like another. Yet His light prevails in all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਪਟ ਕਪਟ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਟ ਵਟ ਨਟ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਅਟ ਪਟ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nipaT kapaT ghaT ghaT naT vaT naT gupat pragaT aT paT jaavadhek hai ||

en.bdb: This world is an illusion. But every creation that is part of this entangled illusion, He, Himself is causing these wondrous acts both conspicuously and latently like a juggler.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਚਨ ਸੋ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT see dhirasaT na dharasan so dharas bachan so bachan na surat samek hai ||

en.bdb: In this creation, no one looks alike, talks alike, thinks alike or sees alike. No one's wisdom is the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੨॥
verses.translit_en: roop rekh lekh bhekh naadh baadh naanaa bidh agam agaadh bodh braham bibek hai ||342||

en.bdb: Living beings are of myriad forms, fortune, posture, sound and rhythm. All this is beyond comprehension and knowledge. In fact it is beyond human capability to understand the strange and wondrous creation of the Lord. (342)
